errata.orig:
When an <info> command has been processed successfully, the EPP
<resData> element MUST contain child elements as described in [2]. In
addition, the EPP <extension> element MUST contain a child
<rgp:infData> element that identifies the registry grace period
namespace and the location of the registry grace period schema.  The
<rgp:infData> element contains a single <rgp:rgpStatus> element that
contains a single attribute "s" whose value describes the current
grace period status of the domain.  Possible status values are
described in section Section 3.1.
errata.correct:
When an <info> command has been processed successfully, the EPP
<resData> element MUST contain child elements as described in [2]. In
addition, the EPP <extension> element MUST contain a child
<rgp:infData> element that identifies the registry grace period
namespace and the location of the registry grace period schema.  The
<rgp:infData> element contains one or more <rgp:rgpStatus> elements that
each contain a single attribute "s" whose value describes one of the the
current grace period status of the domain.  Possible status values are
described in section Section 3.1.
errata.notes:
The XML schema in Section 5 sets the maximum number of occurrences of the <rgpStatus> element to be unbounded, meaning that any number of elements may be present.

This correction updates the text to reflect the XML schema.

errata.orig:
Example "restore request" <update> response:

   S:<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="no"?>
   S:<epp xmlns="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:epp-1.0"
   S:     xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
   S:     xsi:schemaLocation="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:epp-1.0
   S:     epp-1.0.xsd">
   S:  <response>
   S:    <result code="1000">
   S:      <msg lang="en">Command completed successfully</msg>
   S:    </result>
   S:    <extension>
   S:      <rgp:upData xmlns:rgp="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:rgp-1.0"
   S:       xsi:schemaLocation="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:rgp-1.0
   S:       rgp-1.0.xsd">
   S:        <rgp:rgpStatus s="pendingRestore"/>
   S:      </rgp:upData>
   S:    </extension>
   S:    <trID>
   S:      <clTRID>ABC-12345</clTRID>
   S:      <svTRID>54321-XYZ</svTRID>
   S:    </trID>
   S:  </response>
   S:</epp>
errata.correct:
Example "restore request" <update> response:

   S:<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="no"?>
   S:<epp xmlns="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:epp-1.0"
   S:     xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
   S:     xsi:schemaLocation="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:epp-1.0
   S:     epp-1.0.xsd">
   S:  <response>
   S:    <result code="1001">
   S:      <msg lang="en">Command completed successfully; action pending</msg>
   S:    </result>
   S:    <extension>
   S:      <rgp:upData xmlns:rgp="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:rgp-1.0"
   S:       xsi:schemaLocation="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:rgp-1.0
   S:       rgp-1.0.xsd">
   S:        <rgp:rgpStatus s="pendingRestore"/>
   S:      </rgp:upData>
   S:    </extension>
   S:    <trID>
   S:      <clTRID>ABC-12345</clTRID>
   S:      <svTRID>54321-XYZ</svTRID>
   S:    </trID>
   S:  </response>
   S:</epp>
errata.notes: RFC 3915 describes a 2-step restore process in Figure 1: EPP Server State Machine, where the restore request is submitted with the action pending of submitting the restore report.  RFC 5731 and RFC 5733 include a multistep transfer process, where a transfer request returns the response code of "1001" with the message "Command completed successfully; action pending" to indicate that an action is pending to complete the transfer process.  Similarly, the 2-step restore process is pending the action of submitting the restore report, so the correct response code of "1001" with the message "Command completed successfully; action pending" needs to be reflected in the example "restore request" <update> response.

errata.orig: A second <rgp:statement> element that contains a text statement that the information in the restore report is factual to the best of the client's knowledge.  An OPTIONAL "lang" attribute MAY be present to identify the language if English (value "en") is not used to represent the statement.
errata.correct: An OPTIONAL second <rgp:statement> element that contains a text statement that the information in the restore report is factual to the best of the client's knowledge.  An OPTIONAL "lang" attribute MAY be present to identify the language if English (value "en") is not used to represent the statement.
errata.notes:
The XML schema defines the "statement" as a minimum (default) of 1 and a maximum of 2 elements:

   <element name="statement" type="rgp:reportTextType" maxOccurs="2"/>

If the intent was to make 2 statements required, the XML schema would have defined the "statement" element as:

   <element name="statement" type="rgp:reportTextType" minOccurs="2" maxOccurs="2"/>

The XML schema is normative, so to address the gap, the text should define the second statement as OPTIONAL.
